bagPolicy.summary: The A–Z guide lists clear plastic, vinyl or PVC bags up to 14 × 14 × 6 inches or a one-gallon clear bag for events applying the clear-bag policy, but also says bags over 4.5 × 6.5 inches are barred. Because the published limits conflict and concerts may differ, check the concert’s event guide before bringing a bag.
allowed: Clear bag up to 14 × 14 × 6 inches where the event permits
bagPolicy.note: Policies may change or vary by event. Review the linked official guidance shortly before arrival.

parking.summary: The stadium provides event-specific parking and entry instructions in its event guides; use the particular concert’s parking map and pass.
parking.note: Policies may change or vary by event. Review the linked official guidance shortly before arrival.

rideshare.summary: The general stadium A–Z guide does not publish a single rideshare pickup site applicable to every concert.
rideshare.note: Policies may change or vary by event. Review the linked official guidance shortly before arrival.

concessions.summary: Outside food and beverages are prohibited except when the stadium grants an individual medical exception. Food and drinks are sold within the stadium.
concessions.note: Policies may change or vary by event. Review the linked official guidance shortly before arrival.

accessibility.summary: Listening devices are loaned from Guest Services near Section 148 against photo ID. A courtesy cart for mobility-impaired guests operates at select events; request an interpreter at least two weeks ahead.
accessibility.note: Policies may change or vary by event. Review the linked official guidance shortly before arrival.

reEntry.summary: Guests who leave cannot return without a new unused or unscanned ticket.
reEntry.note: Policies may change or vary by event. Review the linked official guidance shortly before arrival.

ticketPickup.summary: The stadium box office opens on event days, but the A–Z guide does not give a universal will-call location for concerts; the North Rollup listed there is for bowl games only.
ticketPickup.note: Policies may change or vary by event. Review the linked official guidance shortly before arrival.

gates.summary: Six public gates A–F serve different seating areas; follow the ticket and concert event guide for the appropriate gate and opening time. Guests and their belongings are screened.
gates.note: Policies may change or vary by event. Review the linked official guidance shortly before arrival.
